# DergiPark

> > DergiPark is Turkey's national academic journal hosting platform operated by TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM, providing open access to peer-reviewed Turkish scholarly publications across medical, social sciences, and humanities disciplines.

DergiPark serves as the primary repository for Turkish academic journals, hosting publications indexed in TR Dizin, DOAJ, EBSCO, and ERIH PLUS. The platform supports both active journals and discontinued archives across multiple disciplines, with content available in Turkish and English.

## Key Topics

- DergiPark
- TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM TR DİZİN
- Turkish academic journals
- Peer-reviewed publications (hakemli-dergi)
- Open access publishing (DOAJ)
- Medical journals
- Social sciences journals (sosyal-bilimler-dergisi)
- Multidisciplinary research (disiplinlerarası)
- Turkish-English bilingual content
- EBSCO indexing
- ERIH PLUS
- Journal archives
- Physiotherapy and rehabilitation
- Historical documents (Belgeler)
- Clinical medicine

## Active Medical Journals

- [Türk Fizyoterapi ve Rehabilitasyon Dergisi](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/tjpr): Turkish Journal of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation homepage - peer-reviewed publication by Türkiye Fizyoterapistler Derneği
- [Türk Plastik Rekonstrüktif Ve Estetik Cerrahi Dergisi](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/turkplastsurg): Turkish Plastic Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery Journal homepage - specialized surgical publication

## Social Sciences and Humanities Journals

- [İnönü Üniversitesi Uluslararası Sosyal Bilimler Dergisi (INIJOSS)](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/inijoss): İnönü University International Social Sciences Journal - multidisciplinary social sciences publication indexed in TR Dizin and ERIH PLUS
- [Belgeler](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/belgeler): Turkish Historical Society (Türk Tarih Kurumu) archival documents journal - historical research and primary sources

## Discontinued Journal Archives

- [Klinik Tıp Bilimleri](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/ktb): Clinical Medical Sciences discontinued journal archive - historical medical research collection
- [Medical Sciences (NWS)](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/nwsamed): Medical Sciences discontinued journal archive - preserved medical publications
